steps.speaker: Bass
steps.content: Benna! You... you broke the machine again!

steps.speaker: Bass
steps.content: Everyone will think Bass did it! They will blame Bass again!

steps.speaker: Bass
steps.content: It's Bass's fault! Bass is no good!

steps.speaker: Benna
steps.content: Child... calm down. It's nothing big, hehe...

steps.speaker: Bass
steps.content: Benna! Fix it together!

steps.speaker: Benna
steps.content: Oh? You want Benna to come fix it? I'll go call him for you.

steps.speaker: Bass
steps.content: You forgot again! You are Benna.

steps.speaker: Benna
steps.content: Oh... haha, right. What a lousy memory I have.

steps.speaker: Benna
steps.content: Okay, let's fix it together... Let me see...

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: I'll do it.

steps.speaker: Bass
steps.content: Eve!

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: I know, it's not Bass's fault. It's not Benna's fault either.

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: Here, look... this part is rusty and enlarged, and all the parts behind it are misplaced. That's why the circuit broke. We just need to replace them.

steps.speaker: Bass
steps.content: Eve is amazing! Applause!

steps.speaker: Bass
steps.content: With Eve, the toy factory will get better and better!

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: I am of no help... I'm just a burden to my mom and dad.

steps.speaker: Benna
steps.content: Who would consider their own child a burden... Shanna is talking nonsense again.

steps.speaker: Benna
steps.content: Grandpa never considered Shanna a burden. Grandpa will leave all his treasures to Shanna.

steps.speaker: Bass
steps.content: ...Benna thinks Eve is his granddaughter again! Even dumber than Bass.

steps.speaker: Bass
steps.content: Eve is Eve! She's the smartest person in this toy factory!

steps.speaker: Bass
steps.content: When Eve grows up, she will design a lot of amazing toys, right?

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: Me? I don't know...

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: I drew some designs, but it looks like mom and dad are very busy, so I won't show them. I don't want to bother them.

steps.speaker: Benna
steps.content: Then give it to Grandpa. I'm happy with anything Shanna does.

steps.speaker: Bass
steps.content: Eve's toys will definitely be awesome! Bass believes that! Bass wants to be the first to play!

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: No problem. Bass will be the first one to play with them.

steps.speaker: Bass
steps.content: Then Bass wants a screaming chicken! Cluck, cluck, cluck... Like in that cartoon! Tall and strong! To protect! Eve!

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: What about Benna? What kind of toy do you like?

steps.speaker: Benna
steps.content: Um... I don't really know...

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: Hmm... Then think of one for Shanna? What does Shanna like?

steps.speaker: Benna
steps.content: A rubber ball! She loves playing with one... I remember it clearly!

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: Okay, I'll make them for you guys.

steps.speaker: Bass
steps.content: Let's make a pinky promise.

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: It's a promise.
